READ THE ROAD

Automatic acceleration. Steer with A/D or ←/→.
Brake with S or ↓ before tight bends.

02
STRAIGHTEN. THEN BOOST.

Hold Space for a short burst. The reservoir refills while driving. Touch controls are provided.

03

Center on the marked ramp at 160+ km/h.
The car jumps automatically. Boost is optional.
